keyword: when was the last mission to the moon

verifications.claim: The last time humans went to the moon was during NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Last time American on moon, Apollo 17" (R1); "The last time astronauts traveled that far was Apollo 17, in December 1972" (R2); "Apollo 17 — the final mission in the program, which was the last time humans traveled to the moon" (R3); "Apollo 17 became the last crewed mission to the Moon" (R4); "his footprints would be the last to impress the lunar soil for a while... Apollo 17" (R5); "Apollo 17... last Apollo Moon landing flight" (R6); "the last humans to visit the Moon... Apollo 17" (R7); "The last U.S. astronaut to land on the moon was... Apollo 17" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state Apollo 17 as the last human/crew lunar mission.

verifications.claim: NASA's Apollo 17 mission landed on December 11, 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "On Dec. 14, 1972, following three days exploring" (R6, implies Dec 11 landing); "Apollo 17 landed on the Moon... on December 11, 1972" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R7 directly states the landing date; R6 supports via context of three days before Dec 14 liftoff.

verifications.claim: NASA's Apollo 17 mission returned to Earth on December 19, 1972.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple references confirm splashdown/return on Dec 19, 1972.
